capture_notes: Six native, unframed Simulator captures from October 6–7, 2026. Production SwiftUI views use deterministic sample input and players. Upload PNG bytes are preserved; their RGB pixels match the original captures. No frames, promotional text, cropping or retouching are added. Existing feature artwork is from September 2026.

app_store_source_notes.preservation: Five English marketing PNGs copied byte-for-byte, including existing headlines and device frames.
